n1.weight_center: subtract recipient-type median log density before fixed clipping; before n1 first fit

n2.output_log_expression_cap: late-type observed gene maximum + log(2), fixed before first run

n3.phenotype_features: source-stage full-panel type centroids, cosine distance; outcome rates excluded from neighbor search

o2.representation: SVD of train-type raw-mean log ratios, not exponentiated old expression-space delta

validation.split: same 60/20/20 stratified cell split as R1; reserved inner cells unused

candidate_policy: All non-NO_OP full-size candidates passing frozen engineering/official contract gates may ship for server arbitration; scientific proxy comparisons do not block compliant submissions
data_policy: Only official E8.5/E9.5 RNA and existing scored T1 models; no external data or hidden future truth

composition.unsupported_types: recipient support only; report cannot synthesize absent late types

mass.shrinkage: squared step / (squared step + asymptotic sampling variance)

stack.operator: apply frozen density donor indices to frozen mass whole rows; no second density step
